event.name: Auction Night 2026 — The Morning-After Awards
event.valueModelNote: Sealed 'Claude value' is a tongue-in-cheek retention model; most fringe players valued ~$1. STEAL/OVERPAY verdicts are for fun.

awards.title: All Gas, No Brakes
awards.blurb: Spent $2,900 of $3,000. League-high 6 overpays, including $160 for J.Timber — sealed value: $1. Whole-squad model edge: +$95. That's a tip, not a portfolio.

awards.title: The Sleeper Agent
awards.blurb: Sat through all 58 phase-one sales — 2 hours 14 minutes — without a single bid. First purchase: 2h 40m into the night. Some people meditate. Robbie auctions.

awards.title: Overpay of the Night
awards.blurb: Šeško for $410. Sealed value: $8. The model priced him like a phone case. Varun priced him like the phone.

awards.title: 420 Blaze It
awards.blurb: Hard ceiling: $420, not a dollar more (Szoboszlai, obviously). Left with $1,352 unspent and still lifted Gyökeres at $180 (valued $432) and Bruno G. at $70 (valued $324).

awards.title: The Index Fund
awards.blurb: 1,656 last-season points bought for $1,648 — exactly $1.00 per point. He didn't beat the market. He IS the market.

awards.title: The Costco Membership
awards.blurb: 43 cents per last-season point: 1,428 points for $610. His squad finished within 189 points of Lakshman's $2,626 one. Bulk pricing is real.

awards.title: The Gini Coefficient Trophy
awards.blurb: Squad inequality: 0.81 — where 0 is communism and 1 is one Norwegian owning everything. Median player price: $5. A failed state with a great striker.

awards.title: Department of Defence
awards.blurb: Milo invested $1,175 in defenders — 57% of his spend. Lakshman spent $5: five defenders at $1 each. Gameweek 6 will name the winner.

awards.title: The Exchange Rate
awards.blurb: Paid $30.10 per FPL-sticker-million, the league's worst rate. Robbie bought the same currency at $6.90. One of you got the tourist menu.

awards.title: Buy High, Sell Never
awards.blurb: Average lot price: $718 in the first half hour, $1.00 at the close. Lakshman's cash moved at average minute 36 — the exact top of the market. Robbie's at minute 174, short-selling the room.

awards.title: The Ten-Minute Heater
awards.blurb: $980 in one ten-minute window — Gibbs-White $490 and Thiago $490, back to back around minute 65. The room could only watch.
